instruction: Candid documentary photograph from a wide, high angle in a motion capture lab with a red carpet and an office printer in the background. On the right, the man in the black t-shirt and blue shorts (R1), wearing a black skullcap, playfully lifts his right leg towards the woman in the white t-shirt with a red pattern and blue jeans (R2), who stands on the left facing him. The room is brightly lit by overhead lights, casting soft shadows on the red floor.
